observed: BusyBox updater returned nonzero and preserved installed slot, but failed the pre-extraction ARCHIVE_UNSAFE assertion; exact alternate error was not included by the test's bare assertion.
cause: The r1 verbose-tar guard accepts any line starting with '-'. BusyBox prints hardlinks with regular file mode and a trailing ' -> target', so first-character checks do not exclude them.
correction: Reject both GNU hardlink and BusyBox link annotations before accepting file mode; improve assertion diagnostics.
